phase: Corporate Investment — Supplemental Exact Source Materialisation
purpose: Retain exact provider bytes and level-only normalized series for the two official sources required by the preregistered corporate-investment measurement design: Romania S11 gross value added and calendar/seasonally adjusted real GDP. This gate does not derive year-on-year growth, construct investment-grant support intensity, aggregate lending rates, join sources, select lags, fit parameters or open evaluation.

sources.concept: Romania S11 gross value added, quarterly, neither seasonally nor calendar adjusted, current prices, domestic currency
sources.role: denominator source for preregistered trailing-four-quarter investment-grants-support intensity

sources.institution: ECB Data Portal / Eurostat national accounts
sources.concept: Romania real GDP, quarterly, calendar and seasonally adjusted, chain-linked volume, millions of euro
sources.role: level source for preregistered year-on-year real activity growth

next_gate: After exact source-vintage retention, review and pin the immutable artifact, then derive only the transformations frozen by the measurement-design contract offline.
